# WaitOnEvent

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Waits for bits on an event, then clears them.

!!! info "Library helper"
    Implemented in `zuzu.h` on top of the syscalls; it has no syscall number of its own.

```c
EventWaitResult WaitOnEvent(Handle ev, Duration timeout);
```

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ev` | in | Event handle with PERM_WAIT. |
| `timeout` | in | Milliseconds to wait, or TIMEOUT_POLL / TIMEOUT_INFINITE. |

## Returns

The unpacked result; status as for WaitOn().
